# Shifts fixtures

Live sanitized capture: **2026-10-29** re-check (first captured 2026-10-28),
generated by `tool/shifts_capture.dart`. Shift names/ids/timestamps are
sanitized; no credentials are stored.

## Existing live fixtures (unchanged)

- `shifts_list.json` - page 1, pageSize 25, sort startTime; unchanged on recheck.
- `shift_options.json` - live selector source, pageSize 100, statusId 1; 22 rows.
- `shifts_list_filtered.json` - statusId=1, pageSize 5.
- `shift_detail.json` - shift 25, overnight, `timeZone` not part of shift.
- `shift_not_found.json` - `SHIFT_NOT_FOUND`.
- `shifts_forbidden_employee.json` - employee account, `ACCESS_DENIED`.

## Added fixtures

| File | HTTP | Provenance | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shift_create_morning.json` | 201 | Postman saved example (sanitized) | 09:00-12:00, active, id 1 |
| `shift_create_evening.json` | 201 | Postman saved example (sanitized) | 14:00-19:00, active, id 2 |
| `shift_create_night.json` | 201 | Postman saved example (sanitized) | 19:00-02:00, overnight, active, id 3 |
| `shift_update.json` | 200 | Postman saved example (sanitized) | Updated grace, modified timestamp |
| `shift_deactivate.json` | 200 | Synthesized from audit/contract | Success shape, `statusId 2` / `InActive` |
| `shift_activate.json` | 200 | Synthesized from audit/contract | Success shape, `statusId 1` / `Active` |
| `shift_duplicate_name.json` | 409 | Synthesized from audit | `SHIFT_DUPLICATE_NAME`, field `shiftName` |
| `shift_validation_same_time.json` | 400 | Synthesized from audit | `VALIDATION_ERROR` for equal start/end |
| `shift_in_use.json` | 409 | Synthesized from audit | `SHIFT_IN_USE` |
| `shift_already_active.json` | 409 | Synthesized from audit | `SHIFT_ALREADY_ACTIVE` |
| `shift_already_inactive.json` | 409 | Synthesized from audit | `SHIFT_ALREADY_INACTIVE` |
| `shifts_unauthorized.json` | 401 | Synthesized from audit | `AUTH_UNAUTHORIZED` envelope |

Two saved Postman examples were **not** copied: the "create equal times" example
is a 201 success (the request must be 400), and the "deactivate in use" example
is a 200 success (the request must be 409 `SHIFT_IN_USE`). Both were replaced by
audit-derived error fixtures.

Observed contract: times are `HH:mm:ss`; `durationMinutes`, `crossesMidnight`,
`punchInOpensAt`, `earlyPunchInMinutes`, `lateGraceMinutes`,
`activeAssignments`, `statusId/status`, `createdOn`, nullable `modifiedOn`.
Writes follow audit/Postman and were not executed live.
